title: Company Group Project - The Perfect Shift
description: A group project created specifically for a company in a team of 10 people. Held meetings and visited the HQ of GemOne and TVH.

title: Unreal Project: Zombie Simulation
description: A simulation of the AI of a Survivor in a Zombie apocalypse made in Unreal Engine 5. Using provided techniques such as Behavior Trees.

title: Graphics Rasterizer
description: A dual rasterizer project made using SDL. Has a CPU and a GPU mode. Main goal was exploring the fundamentals behind rendering.

title: Solo Game Project - The Shelter
description: Small atmospheric horror game made in the span of one month. Focuses on gameplay programming as well as environment and atmosphere.

title: Lua Bindings with C++
description: Linking a C++ Game Engine to a small abstract game created on Lua using SOL2.

title: Game AI Systems
description: A project focused on implementing different AI Systems in Unreal Engine 5. Including Steering behaviors, Pathfinding, FSM...

title: JPS Algorithm Research
description: A research on Jump Point Search - alternative to A* for pathfinding. Made entirely on my custom engine with needed patterns and technology.

title: 3D Diorama - Amsterdam
description: The highest-effort 3D project I've worked on. Made for a university assignment.

title: First Steps - Unity
description: My High-school graduation project, being my first real try creating a full-fledged game in Unity. Exploring audience reach, feedback, presentation.
